integrity: The derivation is symbolic from the published cycle axioms and Fraisse/QE results. A standalone exact replay enumerates all admissible ternary tables through three diversity atoms and checks the formulas independently.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the Fraisse limit of the atom-structure class FSIASe, not an enumeration of finite relation algebras themselves.
General Stirling transforms of injective orbit profiles are classical; the originality claim is the explicit specialization to Koussas's generic atom structure.
The asymptotic statement concerns numbers of complete tuple types/orbits, not a probability distribution on tuples in the countable model.
title: Stirling type spectrum of the generic symmetric-integral relation-algebra atom structure
